For a DPSK system, consider the message sequence
110 111 001 010. If we choose a 1 as the reference bit
to begin the encoding process then the transmitted
phase carrier for the system is
(a)
0 00π πππ 0ππ 00π
(b)
1 00π πππ 0ππ 00π
(c)
π ππ0 000 π00 ππ0
(d)
None of these
